Home loan EMI didn't change after the RBI repo rate hike? Check your loan tenure.

RBI raised the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50% on 7 October 2026. If your lender keeps your EMI the same at reset, the extra interest is added as extra months at the end of your loan.

Example: a ₹50 lakh home loan, 20 years, rate moves from 8.00% to 8.25%.
Keep the EMI: about 12 more EMIs, about ₹4.96 lakh extra interest.
Raise the EMI by ₹781: tenure unchanged, about ₹1.88 lakh extra interest.

RBI's rate reset rules for EMI loans let you choose a higher EMI, a longer tenure or both, prepay at any time, and get a quarterly statement showing EMIs left. Save the 10 minute check on slide 7 for before the December policy.

Send this to the friend who says "my EMI didn't change".

Sources: RBI Monetary Policy Statement, 7 Oct 2026; RBI circular on reset of floating interest rate on EMI based loans, 18 Aug 2023 (updated 1 Oct 2025). Example figures are an illustrative TrueYards calculation for a new loan over the full tenure; your numbers depend on your lender and loan terms. Photo: Danish Puri / Unsplash. Other images: AI-generated imagery.

Educational content, not advice.

Is your flat legal? 3 words decide it: RERA, CC, OC.

RERA: the project is registered with your state's real estate regulator.
CC: the building was built as per the approved plan.
OC: the building is fit to live in.

Ask to see all three before you pay any token money.

Education only, not legal advice. Certificate names and steps vary by state. Source: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, and state building bye-laws.

Office leasing just hit a record. Here's what it means for homes.

1. 61.06 million sq ft of office space leased in India's top 7 markets in Jan-Sep 2026, a record (JLL); Jul-Sep alone 23.17 million
2. Bengaluru: 17.11 million sq ft, up 15.4%, 28% of all leasing
3. Hyderabad: 9.93 million sq ft, up 32%, fastest among big markets
4. Pune +31.6%, Mumbai +17.7%; Mumbai office vacancy at a 16-year low
5. Global capability centres leased 26.2 million sq ft (42.9% share), up 30.6%
6. Why homes care: offices bring jobs, jobs need homes nearby; rental demand near hubs often moves first (a pattern, not a guarantee)
7. The catch: a record 43.7 million sq ft of new office supply; vacancy still 14.8%

Buying to rent out? Look for growing office hubs, good transit and limited new housing. Office REITs are the small-ticket way to own office income. Not investment advice.

Save this before your next property search. Share it with someone house-hunting near a tech park.

Source: JLL office market data via BW Businessworld (26 Oct 2026).

Getting the keys to your new flat? Run these 8 checks first.

1. The OC: no Occupancy Certificate, no clearance to live in
2. Carpet area: measure and match it to your agreement for sale
3. Walls and damp: cracks, patches, uneven paint near bathrooms and windows
4. Water and power: every tap, flush, switch and socket; meter transfer
5. Doors and floors: locks, smooth closing, hollow-sounding tiles, promised fittings
6. Final dues: a written statement, receipts, bank NOC if the loan is closed
7. Snag list: photos with dates, signed by the builder. Under RERA, builders must fix structural defects reported within 5 years of possession, usually within 30 days
8. Papers: possession letter, OC, society and maintenance details, warranties, property tax and electricity name transfer

Save this for possession day. Share it with someone whose flat is almost ready.

Source: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, Sec. 14(3). General guidance, not legal advice.

Got a Diwali bonus? Here's why your brain wants to blow it.

1. Mental accounting: your brain files a bonus as "extra" money (Richard Thaler, Nobel 2017)
2. "I deserve it" approves the phone upgrade before the money even lands
3. Festive sales are timed for exactly this money
4. Taxman first: at the 30% slab + cess, a Rs 50,000 bonus is ~Rs 34,400 in hand (our calc)
5. Clear card dues at ~36-45% a year first (typical, est.)
6. Rs 34,400 at an assumed 12% a year ≈ Rs 1.07 lakh in 10 years (illustrative)
7. A simple split: half to goals or debt, a third to your emergency fund, the rest guilt-free (illustrative)
8. Move the goal money the day it lands, before you open a shopping app

Tag the friend whose bonus is already in their cart. Save this for bonus day.

Waited a year to buy? Here's what it cost you in your city.

A 1,000 sq ft flat at ANAROCK's average city price, Jul-Sep 2026 vs a year earlier (our calc):
1. Mumbai region (+4%): ~Rs 1.73 cr → ~Rs 1.80 cr, about Rs 6.9 lakh more
2. Bengaluru (+8%): ~Rs 89 L → ~Rs 96 L, about Rs 7.1 lakh more
3. Pune (+6%): ~Rs 79 L → ~Rs 84 L, about Rs 4.8 lakh more
4. Hyderabad (+6%): ~Rs 77 L → ~Rs 82 L, about Rs 4.6 lakh more
5. Chennai (+5%): ~Rs 70 L → ~Rs 73 L, about Rs 3.5 lakh more
6. Kolkata (+7%): ~Rs 61 L → ~Rs 65 L, about Rs 4.3 lakh more

The other side: a year of rent is often cheaper than a year of EMI interest, and supply is ahead of demand (1.14 lakh launches vs ~1 lakh sales last quarter; ~6.3 lakh unsold homes), so buyers can bargain.

Save this before you decide to wait another year. Share it with the friend who keeps saying "next year".

Source: ANAROCK Residential Market Viewpoints Q3 2026 (top 7 cities); year-ago prices derived from its rounded yearly changes. City averages hide big locality gaps.

Indians bought Rs 2,590 crore of digital gold in a month. Nobody regulates it.

1. September digital gold purchases: Rs 2,590 cr, up 83% year on year (~1.7 tonnes)
2. Jan-Sep: 16.3 tonnes, up 76% from 9.2 tonnes a year ago
3. SEBI (Nov 2025): digital gold is neither a notified security nor a regulated commodity derivative, so no SEBI grievance route
4. Your cost: 3% GST on purchase + a buy-sell spread often ~3% (est., varies)
5. Free vault storage usually runs only a few years; coin delivery adds charges
6. Gold ETFs are the regulated route: Rs 4,450 cr of inflows in September, a seven-month high
7. Several AMCs paused fresh money into gold ETF FoFs from 16 Oct; no new SGBs since Feb 2024

Use digital gold as a small convenience, not a vault for your savings. Not investment advice.

Save this before you tap "buy gold" this Dhanteras. Share it with the family member who buys gold on an app.

Sources: World Gold Council India Gold Market Update (Oct 2026) via BusinessToday (25 Oct 2026) and Outlook Money; SEBI caution (8 Nov 2025); 5paisa on gold FoF suspensions (Oct 2026).

The Nifty is near a 52-week low. Should you stop your SIP?

1. The Nifty opened Monday near 22,420, about 1% above its 52-week low of 22,180, after four straight losing sessions
2. It is roughly 15% below its September 2024 peak of ~26,277 (our calc)
3. Why: Brent near $115, foreign investors sold ~Rs 35,861 cr of Indian shares in September, and Infosys cut its growth forecast on Friday
4. Indians did not quit: record Rs 32,490 cr went into SIPs in September; the stoppage ratio fell to 78.5% for a fifth straight month
5. A falling NAV buys you more units: Rs 10,000 buys 100 units at 100, ~118 at 85 (illustrative)
6. Valuations: ~17x forward earnings vs a 10-year average of ~18.9x (early October)
7. History: 2020's ~38% crash recovered within the year; 2008's ~60% fall took nearly three years (approx.)

Keep SIPs for goals 5+ years away. Money needed within 3 years doesn't belong in equity. Short on cash? Pause, don't cancel. Not investment advice.

Save this for the next red day. Share it with the friend who keeps checking their portfolio.

Sources: HDFC Sky market report (26 Oct 2026), AMFI data via Angel One (13 Oct 2026), NSDL/FPI data via Shoonya (5 Oct 2026).

Signing a home loan? Here are 8 terms in plain English.

1. LTV: how much the bank can lend; RBI caps it at 90% up to Rs 30 L, 80% for Rs 30-75 L, 75% above
2. FOIR: all your EMIs as a share of income; many lenders cap it around 50-60% (varies)
3. EBLR: repo rate + the bank's spread; resets when the RBI moves rates
4. Spread: the bank's margin, usually fixed for the loan's life; negotiate it
5. Processing fee: often 0.25-1% + GST (est., varies); festive offers may waive it
6. Pre-EMI: interest-only payments on under-construction homes; it doesn't cut principal
7. KFS: the Key Facts Statement shows the all-in APR; compare APRs, not headline rates
8. Prepayment: no charges on floating-rate home loans to individuals (RBI); fixed-rate loans can carry penalties

Save this before you sign your sanction letter. Share it with someone buying their first home.

Lost your salary tomorrow? Here's how long your savings should last.

The quick test: money you can reach in a day or two ÷ monthly essentials (rent/EMI, food, bills, insurance, fees) = your months.

Under 1 month: living on the edge
1-3 months: getting there
3-6 months: sleeping well
6+ months: bulletproof (beyond ~12, invest the extra)

The common rule of thumb: 6 months of essentials, 3 at minimum, up to 12 if your income is uneven. Example: Rs 50,000 a month x 6 = Rs 3 lakh (illustrative).

Not your emergency fund: gold jewellery, stocks in a falling market, your PF, your credit card limit.

Save this and check your number tonight. Share it with the friend who says "I'll start next month".
